title: Henry Oliver - The Website
text: Hello! I’m Henry Oliver. Over the last decade I’ve worked with universities, state government, and private industry in a variety of data analysis, GIS, and research roles. I have three years of professional experience in groundwater resource management and distribution, and an academic focus on spatial data analysis, and land-use change over time.
